local_changes: Pin direct dependencies to httpx 0.28.1 and mcp 1.26.0.
Explicitly disable HTTP redirects so authorization never crosses origins.
Read and close the transient API-key descriptor before importing third-party modules.
Disable HTTP client environment trust so ambient proxies and CA overrides cannot receive authorization.
Remove the local build backend and project entrypoint; sync only locked dependencies with --no-install-project.
Prepare the locked environment without the user credential; the credential-bearing launch executes cached Python directly against the integrity-checked source.
Validate document and entity identifiers as canonical UUIDs before constructing API paths.
Delegate omitted read and write namespaces to the selected API key instead of injecting a plugin default.
Retry only the audited transient matrix with stable requests and return fixed status/kind errors without response bodies.
Reject explicit empty or whitespace-only namespace intent instead of broadening it to server-default or all-readable scope.
